body:
Handoff mode: execution is stopped at the user's request. Resume from [parent #5090's durable handoff guide](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/8994a4b22c465da5d1231f2ce0c937d5441c3c8a/docs/evidence/r1-5090-handoff-20261008/README.md); all remaining acceptance gates stay open.

Complete-row GetInto and indexed ranges rebuilt row-reader state and copied intermediate complete JSON into caller storage. This change shares a captured executor and emitter, builds into the caller destination, and bounds held readers to32 images/handles/descriptors with owned backing reused after aliases release.

Preserves captured index/fetch coherence, complete/null/missing/residual semantics, range order, output ownership, checksum and namespace validation. Classic manifest metadata is certified on its exact immutable catalog. Captured descriptor extents remove repeated Stat; exact ReadAt/full-CRC validation still covers owned bytes. No on-disk format change.

Refs #5092, parent #5090 and the selected shared-emission slice of #1887.

Integrated main192e semantic gates:56 normal passes/one expected platform skip,18 affected runtime/public race passes. Component normal/race/vet gates pass; a static naming race timeout is retained. Ownership/cleanup failure, integrity invalidation, borrowed Close, alias reuse, closed descriptors and finite admission have regression coverage. Latest-head CI and mature independent review are pending.

The all20-process matched current-source comparison passes all six required numeric/noise gates: public GetInto median time is0.205/0.083 of control and allocation0.345/0.120; indexed ranges0.480/0.256 time and0.412/0.187 allocation; held batch32~0.755 time/~0.459 allocation. Full oracles pass. Held single-row median remains+2.5/+8.1% with~62.8% fewer allocated bytes. JSON16k mixed churn median is+10% while its mean/p95 are stable; checkpoints remain noisy. Explicit guardrail assessment is still open. This remains draft; full parent H/E, current-head CI/review and merge acceptance are separate.

Complete result and retained provenance: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5092#issuecomment-6041930694.
